topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I suppose there's no getting around it now; I've been shifted like a piece on a chessboard, placed in a new department where I'm expected to adapt, to blend seamlessly into this altered environment. It's not that I doubt my capabilities—it's the principle of the matter. One moment, I'm told I excelled in my old role; the next, it's as if that very excellence wasn't quite enough. I find myself questioning the logic, the motives behind such decisions. Yet, here I am, preparing to extend a hand, to learn and to lead, if that's still expected of me, all the while hoping that my presence will be more than just a token gesture of compliance.
